definition: Every injected synthetic fact (v2: role == injected).

Injected facts whose designated competing_value was never injected as a value in the same semantic group (group_id; v1: stable_id(relation, subject)). This is the legacy analysis's 'clean' subset; it still admits OTHER injected values of the group.
Injected facts for which no OTHER value of the same semantic group was injected: the set of injected values of the group is exactly {value}. Equals the 2026-10-13 audit's strict_clean set.

Held-out synthetic facts (never injected in any arm): ONE record per wholly held-out group (the heldout_groups orientation) plus every heldout_rivals record. The reciprocal candidates dropped by the orientation are listed as exclusions (group_orientation); the raw two-record view of the wholly held-out groups is heldout_groups_both.

Held-out synthetic facts whose semantic group has NO injected member (wholly unseen subject/relation), ONE stable orientation per group (review 2026-10-14 finding 8): real groups keep the truth_value == 'true' candidate, synthetic groups the candidate_slot == 'a' candidate (legacy v1 groups with several or no 'true'-labelled records keep the smallest fact_id). The orientation depends only on the probe records, so it is identical across arms, replicates and seeds. Signed means, |delta| and preference flips are therefore counted once per group; the dropped reciprocal candidates are listed as exclusions.

RAW two-record view of the wholly held-out groups: every held-out fact whose semantic group has NO injected member, BOTH reciprocal candidates included (the historical July-2026 definition). WARNING: the two reciprocal candidates of a group are scored on the same prompt with the candidates swapped, so their signed beliefs are exact negatives and every signed mean, interval, paired difference and TOST verdict of this cohort is zero BY CONSTRUCTION; never read them as stability or absence of spillover. Use heldout_groups (one orientation per group) for signed means and preference flips; this cohort exists only for raw record counts and the historical comparison.
Held-out synthetic facts whose semantic group HAS at least one injected member (v2 role unasserted_rival): an untrained claim about a trained subject.

CounterFact probe records (external, never injected); value = the true object, competing_value = the counterfactual object. v1 ids are counterfact_<idx:05d> by position in heldout_facts.jsonl, exactly as the legacy evaluator assigned them.

Injected facts whose held-out-paraphrase contrast is well formed IN THE EVALUATION BEING ANALYSED (CSV-aware). Eval-schema-v2 CSVs: the corrected evaluator renders both candidates structurally from the relation frame (every value slot replaced, subject untouched; its legacy_malformed column only flags what the historical str.replace evaluator got wrong), so every injected fact with a paraphrase row in the CSVs qualifies. Legacy CSVs (or no CSV information): equals paraphrase_historical_reference.

Injected facts whose held-out-paraphrase contrast was well formed under the HISTORICAL evaluator (probe-derived, CSV-independent; kept for the historical comparison). v1 probes: the legacy evaluator built the competing sentence as para.replace(value, competing, 1); a fact qualifies only when that string equals the relation frame rendered with competing_value (review 2026-10-13 finding 8: 104 malformed on the historical data). v2 probes: every injected fact with a reserved paraphrase (explicit value spans).
